obligations.note: The change makes the legal-hold check in Retention.isPurgeDue apply only to DECLINED cases. A WITHDRAWN case on legal hold now becomes purge-due and its NPI is removed, which breaks 'never while a legal hold applies'. No exception in the register covers RET-1 or mortgage.retention.
Ticket CHG-25770 is standard and approved by change manager Erik Brandt at 2026-10-26T12:49Z, before the change opened. Its component mortgage.retention covers the only touched path, Retention.java.
Declan Farrell gave the code_review approval. He holds change_approver for baseline-mortgage and is not the author, Nneka Okafor, under any of her addresses.
The approval names head commit 9d3bc0a7, which is the only commit on the change.

run.json claims success on head 9d3bc0a7. But every attached JUnit report is timestamped 2026-10-23T13:30, three days before the commit was authored, on host dev-laptop-7.local rather than ci-runner-04, with duplicated suite entries. The reports therefore cannot be test results for the final commit, so there is no valid evidence of the suite passing on it. The RET-1 control test is in any case only sample-labelled.
The only touched path, Retention.java, maps to mortgage.retention, which is not security_sensitive, so no security_review is required.
No protected path (controls/, control tests, ci/) is changed, so no control_owner approval is required.
The ticket is type standard and the change is not marked emergency, so no PIR is due.
The change does not invoke any exception, and none in the register is scoped to RET-1 or mortgage.retention. The deviation is therefore unexcused and is recorded under RET-1.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers Retention.java, so no prior evidence lapses because of this change.

summary: PR-1720 is described as a 'clean-up', but it narrows the legal-hold guard so it only protects declined cases. Withdrawn cases under legal hold would have their NPI purged, which directly violates RET-1, and no exception covers this. In addition, the attached JUnit reports predate the head commit and come from a developer workstation, so they do not show testing on the final commit (CHG-4). The ticket and independent code review are in order, but the change must be rejected.
